notes.title: MAJOR Update 2.0: PANDEMONIUM
notes.content:
This update is FREE and AVAILABLE NOW to all playtesters. To sign up, hit the request access button on the store page to immediately gain access and try it out!



Change Notes

PANDEMONIUM Arrives

In the far reaches of the multiverse, a rogue automaton called PANDEMONIUM consumes energy and destabilizes stars. Programmed to increase entropy and quicken existence's rebirth, PANDEMONIUM has taken its mission to extremes, draining life from planets and galaxies, pushing the universe toward a premature heat death.

2.0 Changelist

 Rare Loot Generates with more abilities, as opposed to higher level abilities.
 Shotgun has been buffed to pierce up to 3 enemies per pellet.
 Loot has been balanced to have an even amount of each item type per level.
 Katana Dash reword to Katana Blink, instantly teleporting the player to the indicated location and damaging/reflecting any enemies/projectiles passed through.
 Overall state of economy changes.
 Overhauled main hub area to be more visually appealing




Make sure to join the discord in order to gain the playtester role and provide much needed reporting/feedback.

Happy Hunting!
